data.title: Numbers — Starter · Lesson 5
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
[Ad-lib] ¡Vamos, amigos!

[Hook]
One, two… Uno, dos
Counting at the market, here we go.
Three, four… Tres, cuatro
Learning numbers, let's explore.

[Verse]
Sun's up, let's take a stroll,
fruits and veggies, colors so bright.
Par… even, impar… odd,
finding patterns in the morning light.
Naranjas… oranges, manzanas… apples,
counting with each step we take.
Orden… order, número… number,
in this mercado, we'll learn to make.

[Hook]
One, two… Uno, dos
Counting at the market, here we go.
Three, four… Tres, cuatro
Learning numbers, let's explore.

[Verse]
Décimo… tenth, vigésimo… twentieth,
counting up, we're on a quest.
Cantidad… quantity, in every stall,
from apples to bananas, we count them all.
Contar… to count, as we wander,
through the aisles, voices like thunder.
Quince… fifteen, in a line we stand,
with each purchase, we understand.

[Bridge]
Tercio… third, cuarto… quarter,
sharing with friends, we grow bolder.
In this market, numbers come alive,
